body:
### Problem
When one line of a draft is longer than a whole page, `drafts.page` shows as much of the line as fits, then tells the agent to continue from the next line (`i + 2`) instead of from the rest of this one. Nothing past the cut can be read. The test `a_long_draft_is_read_a_page_at_a_time` only uses short lines, so it misses this, and its doc comment, which says the pages add up to the whole draft, isn't true.

### Done when
- Reading a draft page by page, following each page's continue point, shows every character of the draft once, including lines longer than a page.
- A test with a line longer than a page checks that the pages add up to the whole draft.
title: drafts: page through very long lines
